about: Illustrative value per successful outcome and the owner's quality bar for each use case. These are assumptions, not measurements: each one says how it was reached so an owner can replace it with their own figure. Loaded costs per minute are illustrative.

support-assistant.assumption: An accepted draft saves an agent about 3 minutes of writing, net of the time spent reviewing it, at an illustrative loaded cost of $0.80 a minute.

kyc-review.assumption: An approved summary saves an analyst about 12 minutes of reading, net of review, at an illustrative $1.00 a minute.

fraud-explain.assumption: An explanation used in a decision saves an analyst about 40 seconds at an illustrative $0.90 a minute.

knowledge-assistant.assumption: A useful answer saves an engineer about 30 seconds against the existing wiki search, at an illustrative $1.10 a minute.
knowledge-assistant.qualityBarText: at least 60% of answers rated useful
